text:
Lia: tiny poll — our new desk plant+robot (the one with the little watering arm) needs a name. Pick one by replying or react: 1) Sprout-bot 2) Nori 3) Quiet Larry. Bonus: leave a one-liner about the name to win a sticker. :seedling::robot_face:

Sam: Sprout-bot for the win. One-liner: 'waters your coffee when you're debugging' :seedling:

Morgan: Nori (short for Nora the Nori). One-liner: 'silent meeting companion and seaweed sympathizer' :laughing:

Cherise: Quiet Larry — because it won't interrupt standups. :thumbsup:

Ben: votes Sprout-bot +1. One-liner: 'plants better ideas than I do' :seedling:

Ava: Quick shoutout — Lia, thanks for fixing the kitchen sink leak yesterday :raised_hands: legend.

OpsBot: poll update — Sprout-bot: 2 votes, Nori: 1 vote, Quiet Larry: 1 vote. (automated tally)

Sam: also offering a sticker if someone can rhyme with 'Sprout-bot' in one line.

Morgan: 'Sprout-bot, debug the plot' (not a rhyme?) :stuck_out_tongue:

Cherise: 'Quiet Larry, please don't marry the ficus' — no weddings in the office pls.

Ben: tie-breaker proposal: we let the plant choose by where the sunlight hits at 3pm. scientific.

Lia: love these. We'll give it one more hour then sticker goes to best one-liner. :tada:

Ava: my vote goes to the person who brought cookies today (anonymous hero). also hi to the ficus.

Sam: (reacts with :seedling: :thumbsup:)
